rules: An exact literal is cross-capsule-valid only when immutable host evidence owns it, the owning clean source contains it, and that clean source is reachable through the audited module's source import graph.
Exact target-owned bundle evidence validates clean copy omitted from a curated capsule, but cannot by itself prove implementation of artifact behavior missing from clean source.
Template equality preserves exact static text and interpolation positions while ignoring erased or reconstructed local identifier names.
